name: antigravity-token-telemetry
description: Displays live Antigravity model, context tokens, turn delta, latency (TTFT), and KV cache hits in the native VS Code Status Bar.

antigravity.statusBar.alignment.description: Alignment of the Antigravity telemetry item in the status bar.

antigravity.statusBar.priority.description: Priority order of the status bar item.

antigravity.statusBar.fallbackToGlobal.description: Fall back to global Antigravity telemetry (~/.gemini/antigravity/telemetry) if no workspace file is found.

antigravity.statusBar.enableHealthColors.description: Color status bar item with warning (yellow) or error (red) semaphore backgrounds when context grows large.

antigravity.statusBar.warningThreshold.description: Token count threshold (yellow warning) indicating context footprint is getting heavy.

antigravity.statusBar.criticalThreshold.description: Token count threshold (red error) indicating very large context, recommending a new chat session or file optimization.
